mentions.name: Add Ketchup
mentions.description: A Chrome extension that extracts and summarizes YouTube videos without the user having to click into or watch them, letting users get the gist of a video without the watch time.
mentions.problem: Too much YouTube clickbait requires a long watch time to get the actual content.
mentions.source_excerpt:
just shipped https://addketchup.app/

It's a chrome extension that let's me extract and summarize YouTube videos without even clicking into it.
